description: This Java class handles deserialization and validation of JSON input for creating or updating credit bureau configuration commands within the Fineract platform. It uses helper classes to parse JSON, validate fields, and check for unsupported parameters.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A deserializer and validator for credit bureau configuration commands represented as JSON, supporting creation and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new credit bureau configuration, ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing credit bureau configuration, allowing optional fields but ensuring correctness if provided.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are validation errors accumulated during JSON validation.
